en.2000_Gore_Graham/ending/s0.l81.c6/text:
“GOD FUCKING DAMNIT GORE”

Those words rang out from the president's office, despite the door being shut. In the room, were President Bill Clinton and Vice President Al Gore.'I BROUGHT THE ECONOMY BACK FROM A TERRIBLE STATE RUN BY INCOMPETENT REPUBLICANS. I WON DURING THE MID-TERMS AND GAVE YOU A FREE TICKET TO THE PRESIDENCY. AND WHAT DO YOU DO? YOU LET THE SON OF THE GUY WHO I BEAT BECOME PRESIDENT! 538 VOTES TO 0!' Those were the words of a less than happy Bill Clinton. Gore responded 'I-I don't know what happened, I-I thought I ran a good campaign b-but...' Clinton interrupted, saying 'You know exactly what happened Gore. For some reason, you did a tank photo op like Dukakis, which is already bad enough. BUT THEN you accidentally fired the tank, I have no clue how, those things are hard to fire, and you hit a group of spectators. Killing 5. Your court date is in a month so you better start prepping a defence team.' 'co-' 'If you’re asking me for a pardon, you can shove it. Then in your speech to the nation about it, you claimed the ghost of William Mckinley had fired the tank by controlling your body. You then spent 50 thousand dollars of taxpayer money on hiring an exorcist to try and remove him. That’s why you lost, Al.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/ending/s0.l100.c28/text: You still have many options for your political career as of now. You are still popular in your party and Texas, so there is no doubt you can still influence the next candidate. Perhaps it will be you, or your brother. Maybe the American public will get sick of the Bush family and choose someone else entirely. Whatever the case, let’s hope the Republicans can recover as the Democrats did 8 years ago.

en.2000_Gore_Graham/ending/s0.l113.c28/text: For the first time since 1888, the loser of the popular vote has won the election! en.2000_Gore_Graham/ending/s0.l117.c28/text: What will happen next is up to you, although most people have some expectations. Tax cuts will certainly be going into effect, and some bills related to gay marriage or LGBTQ+ people in the military will as well. Just keep an eye out for 2004, and don't make the same mistakes as your dad.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/ending/s0.l120.c31/text: Well done! You've prevented another term of Democrats and succeeded your father as the next Republican president. en.2000_Gore_Graham/ending/s0.l128.c31/text: Well done! You've prevented another term of Democrats and succeeded your father as the next Republican president. You barely won, however, so let’s hope your bipartisanship and compassionate conservativism resonate with many Americans.

en.2000_Gore_Graham/ending/s0.l166.c28/text: Interestingly enough, you've lost the popular vote despite winning overall, for the first time since 1888. Republicans aren't too happy about losing 3 elections in a row to someone who won less than 50% of the popular vote.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/ending/s0.l174.c12/text:
”As expected, you've lost the 2000 election.”

Congratulations! You received 5% of the popular vote! You will enable the Green Party to run a vigorous campaign in 2004 and present a true choice to the American people. You’ve run a great campaign these last few months, and you should have no problem getting renominated in 4 years.

But for now, sit back and relax, you’ve earned it. Who knows? Maybe next election you’ll even win a state or two.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/ending/s0.l178.c12/text:
”Congratulations! You’ve won D.C.!”

What a campaign! You’ve managed to surpass expectations and net yourself some electoral votes! You should have no trouble gaining federal matching funds next election, and you can take solace in the fact that the people of D.C. chose the only capable man this election.

Democrats are sure to be miffed, especially so if they lost, but you couldn’t care less at this moment. Good luck in 2004!
en.2000_Gore_Graham/ending/s0.l182.c9/text:
”Holy Cow! You won a state!”

Everyone thought it impossible, but you’ve pulled it off! You’re the first third-party candidate in over 30 years to win a state, and both you and your supporters are ecstatic. Federal matching funds in 2004 are all but guaranteed, and you’ve established the green party as a force to be reckoned with.

Let’s hope you’re more than just a flash in the pan and can run a similar campaign in 2004. The Green party may even find itself in the White House someday - and it’s all thanks to you.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/ending/s0.l186.c12/text:
”The Senate will now vote on H.R. 5411, the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2001.”

Those were the words of the clerk in the US Senate. They went through each Senator by state, asking for a voice vote from each of them. After all, was said and done, the tally was 81-19 in favour of the motion. the clerk said 'The motion passes. The bill will now be presented to the president for signing.' He stood up and turned around, only to see president Ralph Nader standing 2 inches behind him, which causes the Clerk to stumble back. 'Oh, h-hello there President Nader. I was just going to pres-' He gets interrupted by the loudest yell he had ever heard, when president Nader bellowed at him:

VETOED!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

president Nader then had his 74th veto overridden that congress just 5 minutes later.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/ending/s0.l190.c12/text:
”Good lord! You’ve won the 2000 election!”

Everyone thought it impossible, that at best you would get 5%, but you’ve proved everybody wrong! This is the biggest political upset in American history, beating out Truman over 50 years ago. An impromptu party has been arranged at the Green Party headquarters in DC, your answering machine is clogged with congratulatory calls from your supporters, and every news station in the country has been clamouring to get to you for an interview

What you've achieved tonight is a stellar victory that will be studied for the rest of American history. From Nader’s Raiders to the White House in 30 years, let’s hope your surprise victory has also netted the Green Party some senate seats, or you’ll have to compromise big in the coming years, considering your stiff opposition from both parties. This definitely wasn’t supposed to happen - Good luck!
en.2000_Gore_Graham/ending/s0.l194.c10/text:
"It is Over"

The results are coming in, and the phone is ringing. You reach slowly into your drawer and pull out something you never thought you would use. The TV announcer drawls, "The biggest loser of tonight is Ralph Nader! Nader appears to have only received
en.2000_Gore_Graham/ending/s0.l194.c305/tex:
votes nationwide." You pull the gun to your head, and slowly press on the trigger... and then there was nothing.

A noise suddenly grabs your attention, but your vision is still fuzzy.

"Ralph, cmon!"

The voice seems strained. Your vision suddenly clears. You are in a white room. As your eyes trail sluggishly around the room, you notice something strange. There are a series of glass pods lining the sides of the room. In each pod, there is a person inside each, with every person having some form of cap on their head.

"Get out of the simulator, Ralph! We have some shopping to do," and then finally, you remembered.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/ending/s0.l198.c12/text:
”As expected, you've lost the 2000 election.”

This was hardly a surprise, considering the stranglehold that the two-party system holds on American politics. To make matters worse, you didn’t even get 5% of the popular vote, so the Green Party will have to do without federal matching funds.

Still, you’ve run a decent campaign, and your campaign has tried the best it could. You have a chance to cross that 5% threshold in the next election at least, considering you’ve been a perennial candidate for 8 years now. Good luck in 2004!

en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3312@0/des: We need to expand benefits for Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid. We can use the surplus as well as defense cuts to balance these increases.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3345@1/des: I can certainly see the need for some legislation, but it should be addressed at the state level.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3310@2/des: We should enact tax cuts to return this money to the American people. My plan will reduce the burden for all Americans who currently pay income tax.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3311@3/des: We should try to keep things as they are. The economy has been unusually good the past few years, and we already have a large federal debt to pay down.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3313@4/des: I would prefer to see us allocate this money to new and existing government programs so that all Americans can share in our prosperity.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3314@5/des: I believe that we need to return control of education to the states and to the people. I would end the Department of Education as President.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3315@6/des: Many schools are squandering the resources of the federal government. I support providing school vouchers directly to parents, so that they can choose where their child goes.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3316@7/des: We need more spending for America's struggling schools, and national standards and testing to identify and fix poor performers. Every child deserves a strong, functional school to attend.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3317@8/des: We need to increase pay for teachers and increase funding for the Department of Education. I don't support nationwide standards or testing -- they will distort the learning process and lead to education by rote.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3318@9/des: The Social Security system is a financial time bomb. We need to get rid of it, or at the very least cut its benefits significantly.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3319@10/de: The average worker would do much better if their money was invested in the stock market. I support a plan to allow workers to contribute at least some of their Social Security contribution to an individual investment account.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3320@11/de: I would establish an iron-clad lockbox for the Social Security fund. When we allow the federal government to borrow our Social Security money, we put every senior in this country at risk.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3321@12/de: We need to increase benefits for Social Security. Many people can barely survive on the monthly payment, while we spend billions on the military and run a huge budget surplus.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3322@13/de: The Cold War is over. We should cut defense spending and stop operating so many bases overseas. I would pull troops out of places like Germany and Okinawa, where we are no longer defending anything.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3323@14/de: America should remain tough, but humble. I am concerned about some of our recent interventions in places like Somalia and Serbia.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3324@15/de: We need to remain an engaged, committed defender of human rights in the world. We should do everything possible to secure the friendship of nations like Russia and China, and to prevent atrocities and genocide in the developing world.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3325@16/de: I would focus on removing dictators like Saddam Hussein and Kim Jong Il from power. They threaten the stability of the world and perpetrate evil upon their people.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3326@17/de: Bill Clinton was an embarrassment to the United States, and his impeachment was well-deserved. I believe that he should have been removed from office.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3327@18/de: I don't think we need to belabor the point. I pledge to the American people that I will restore honor and dignity to the White House when I am President.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3328@19/de: I am my own man. I respect Bill Clinton in many ways, but his personal conduct was lacking in this case.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3329@20/de: This is a non-issue. Bill Clinton is one the best Presidents of the last fifty years, and we should be focusing on his policies and successes, not his personal affairs.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3330@21/de: Returning Elian to Cuba was unconscionable. I did not support this decision by the Clinton Administration.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3331@22/de: We should be talking less about Elian, and more about my plans to expand upon the great prosperity of this nation.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3332@23/de: The law is the law. Elian belongs in Cuba with his father. These questions are never easy, but the Clinton Administration and Janet Reno did what they had to do.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3333@24/de: This was an issue that had no bearing on the security of the United States. We also ruined any chance of mediation by insisting on the autonomy of Kosovo.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3334@25/de: This certainly helped unseat Slobodan Milosevic, but as President I will make sure that America treads carefully before intervening in foreign nations' affairs.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3335@26/de: I support our actions in this theatre. For minimal cost we were able to stop a potential genocide and put a dictator to justice.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3336@27/de: The bombing of Serbia killed many innocent civilians and increased antagonism with Russia and China. I believe military intervention should be a last resort.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3337@28/de: We need huge tax cuts across the board. Corporate, personal, and capital gains taxes should be slashed. This will further expand the economy through increases in investment.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3338@29/de: My budget will cut taxes and return a portion of our budget surplus to the American people. Everybody who pays taxes will receive a reduction.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3339@30/de: We have a plan for middle class tax cuts. But it would be irresponsible to make huge changes while we still have a large debt.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3340@31/de: I have no plan to cut taxes. If anything, we might need some increases to strengthen Social Security.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3341@32/de: I support a strong, overwhelming response against whoever perpetrated this attack. Any government that harbors such terrorists should be overthrown, even if it requires the commitment of American troops.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3342@33/de: We need to do two things -- first of all we need better procedures to ensure that our forces in dangerous regions do better at protecting themselves. Secondly, we will investigate who is responsible for this attack, be it Al-Qaeda or some other group, and attack them accordingly.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3343@34/de: This attack was a tragedy, but it underscores the need to the United States to have a more limited foreign policy. The Cold War is over, and it doesn't make sense to deploy troops in so many parts of the world.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3344@35/de: A crime is a crime, no matter what the motive is. I do not support ideas that some victims should be held in higher regard than others.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3346@36/de: I support increased federal hate crime legislation. No American should ever feel like a target of intimidation because of their identity.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3370@37/de: Over a million unborn children are killed every year in this country. We need judges who will overturn Roe v. Wade, or we need a Constitutional Amendment to end the practice of abortion.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3371@38/de: I am a pro-life candidate for President, but I understand that we have certain legal protections in place. At the very least, we can end taxpayer funding for this practice.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3372@39/de: My goal as President will be to reduce abortions in this country to the lowest level possible. We can increase education and funding for contraception, to reduce unwanted pregnancies. I might be open to ending late-term abortions.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3373@40/de: I strongly support the right of a woman to choose. We need to defend this right, and we should increase funding for women's health services, unconditionally.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3381@41/de: Absolutely. Anything we can do to work towards energy independence in this country is a positive step. Oil and coal are the foundation of any energy policy, and should be exploited as much as possible.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3382@42/de: This is fine with me, but it is a small part of the overall solution. We need to drill wherever we can, while encouraging innovation in other sectors of the energy market.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3383@43/de: I oppose these plans. The ANWR is an environmental treasure of the United States, and the oil gained from any exploitation will be relatively limited.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3384@44/de: This is a giveaway to oil companies that will not resolve America's underlying energy issues. We need more government investment in renewable energy sources, and strict regulations on oil and coal.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3385@45/de: This is clear political gamesmanship which I cannot support in good conscience. The Reserve should be used in cases of national emergency only. Furthermore, why did Clinton announce this decision so close to the election?
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3386@46/de: I understand the impulse to help America's families, but the Reserve should be used in cases of national emergency only. This action is unwise.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3387@47/de: Oil prices have spiked to nearly $40 a barrel. We need to help hard-working Americans in states like New Hampshire by making temporary allowances from our reserve.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3388@48/de: Absolutely. This is just another example of meddling that harms the economy, hurts energy production, and puts hard-working Americans out of work.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3389@49/de: Unfortunately, coal is one of the dirtiest forms of energy in existence. I don't see how we can continue to rely on it for the majority of America's energy needs.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3397@50/de: The Clinton Administration has added 23 million jobs to the American economy and unleashed an unprecedented wave of prosperity and innovation. I will continue his policies as President so that all Americans can prosper in the coming years.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3398@51/de: We must not undo eight years of progress under President Clinton by cutting key programs and squandering the surplus on tax cuts for the rich. My opponent not only lacks experience, but his conservative ideas are out of step with those of the American public.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3399@52/de: I stand here tonight as my own man. We have much more work to do to ensure that America's prosperity flows to all of the people. We need more spending for education, infrastructure, and important research. We also need to protect Social Security, Medicare, and the environment.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3400@53/de: I stand here tonight as my own man. I will work day and night to support the hard-working American people. I will make sure our debt is paid down, and that senior citizens and middle class families are protected into the future. I will protect our most important programs from attacks and budget cuts.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3409@54/de: We will hammer Bush on his lack of experience and qualifications for the Presidency. We should point to the tactics his operatives used to defeat John McCain as evidence that he is not nearly as moderate and conciliatory as he claims to be. We will point out his connections to America's economic elites.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3410@55/de: Why screw up a good thing? I will campaign on the positive record of Bill Clinton and the Democrats over the past eight years, and pledge to continue those policies. I will appear with Clinton at a few rallies during the campaign to make sure Americans get the message.
en.2000_Gore_Graham/answers_json/3411@56/de: It is important to shore up our support from liberal Democrats, especially with Ralph Nader in the race. I will pledge to increase spending on our most valued social programs, continue to increase taxes on high-earners like Clinton did, and I will look for other areas where I can appeal to the left.

zh.2000_Gore_Graham/ending/s0.l77.c7/text:
“差距太小，无法判定胜负！”

佛罗里达州的胜负差距不到半个百分点，而整个大选又取决于该州的结果，因此州内重新计票将决定胜负。你和对手都会穷尽各类法院途径和法律程序，做好打持久战的准备吧。但愿这场民主根本程序的拖延，不会让任何关键政府机构准备不足。那可就真的糟了！
zh.2000_Gore_Graham/ending/s0.l81.c6/text:
“戈尔，你他妈的搞什么！”

总统办公室的门关着，吼声却还是传了出来。屋里是比尔·克林顿总统和阿尔·戈尔副总统。“我把被无能共和党人搞得一塌糊涂的经济救了回来。我赢了中期选举，把总统宝座拱手送到你面前。可你干了什么？你居然让那个被我打败的家伙的儿子当上总统！538票对0票！”克林顿显然气坏了。戈尔回答：“我、我不知道怎么回事，我、我以为我的竞选搞得挺好，可、可是……”克林顿打断了他：“你很清楚怎么回事，戈尔。你不知抽了什么风，学杜卡基斯坐坦克拍宣传照，光这就够糟了。可你随后居然误开了炮——我都不知道你怎么办到的，那玩意儿可没那么容易开火——击中了一群观众，死了五个人。一个月后你就要出庭，最好赶紧找个辩护团队。”“克——”“要是想求我赦免你，免谈。然后你向全国解释这件事时，居然说麦金莱的鬼魂控制了你的身体，替你开的炮。你还花了五万美元纳税人的钱，请驱魔师把他赶走。阿尔，这就是你输掉的原因。

zh.2000_Gore_Graham/ending/s0.l174.c12/text:
”不出所料，你输掉了2000年大选。”

恭喜！你获得了5%的普选票！你将让绿党能够在2004年开展有力的竞选，为美国人民提供真正的选择。过去几个月，你打了一场漂亮的竞选战，四年后再次获得提名，应当不成问题。

不过现在，坐下来放松一下吧，这是你应得的。谁知道呢？也许下次选举，你甚至能赢下一两个州。
zh.2000_Gore_Graham/ending/s0.l178.c12/text:
”恭喜！你赢得了哥伦比亚特区！”

好一场竞选！你超出了人们的预期，拿到了一些选举人票！下次选举，你应当不难取得联邦配套资助；哥伦比亚特区的人民选择了本次选举中唯一有能力的人，这也能让你感到欣慰。

民主党人肯定恼火，尤其是他们输掉大选的时候，但你此刻根本不在乎。祝你2004年好运！
zh.2000_Gore_Graham/ending/s0.l182.c9/text:
”天哪！你赢下了一个州！”

所有人都认为不可能，但你做到了！你是三十多年来首位赢下一个州的第三党候选人，你和支持者都欣喜若狂。2004年的联邦配套资助几乎已经有了保障，你也让绿党成为一股不容忽视的力量。

但愿你不只是昙花一现，2004年还能打出同样的竞选成绩。绿党甚至有一天可能入主白宫——这一切都要归功于你。
zh.2000_Gore_Graham/ending/s0.l186.c12/text:
”参议院现在将对H.R. 5411号法案，即《2001财年国防授权法》进行表决。”

这是美国参议院书记员的话。他们按州逐一询问参议员，请每个人口头投票。全部结束后，结果为81票赞成、19票反对。书记员说：“议案通过。法案现在将提交总统签署。”他站起身转过头，却发现拉尔夫·纳德总统就在身后两英寸处，吓得他踉跄后退。“啊，您、您好，纳德总统。我正要呈——”他的话被一声生平听过最响的吼叫打断，纳德总统冲他咆哮：

否决!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

仅仅五分钟后，纳德总统在本届国会期间的第74次否决，就被国会推翻了。
zh.2000_Gore_Graham/ending/s0.l190.c12/text:
”老天！你赢得了2000年大选！”

所有人都认为这不可能，觉得你顶多拿到5%，但你证明他们全都错了！这是美国历史上最大的政治冷门，超过了五十多年前杜鲁门的胜选。绿党在哥伦比亚特区的总部临时举办了庆祝聚会，你的电话答录机塞满了支持者的祝贺来电，全国每家新闻台都争着采访你

你今晚取得的是辉煌的胜利，美国历史研究将永远关注它。三十年间，从“纳德突击队”走到白宫，但愿你意外胜选的同时，也为绿党赢得了一些参议院席位；否则，面对两党强烈反对，你在未来几年就不得不作出很大妥协。这根本不该发生——祝你好运！
zh.2000_Gore_Graham/ending/s0.l194.c10/text:
"结束了"

结果陆续传来，电话响起。你慢慢把手伸进抽屉，拿出一件从没想过会用到的东西。电视播音员拖着腔调说：“今晚最大的输家是拉尔夫·纳德！纳德看来在全国只获得了

票。”你把枪举到头边，慢慢扣下扳机……然后，一切归于虚无。

一个声音突然引起了你的注意，但你的视线仍然模糊。

“拉尔夫，快点！”

声音似乎有些吃力。你的视线突然清晰起来。你在一间白色的房间里。目光迟缓地扫过房间，你发现了一件怪事：房间两侧排列着一系列玻璃舱。每个舱里都有一个人，每个人头上都戴着某种帽子。

“快从模拟器里出来，拉尔夫！我们还得去买东西呢。”终于，你想起来了。
zh.2000_Gore_Graham/ending/s0.l198.c12/text:
”不出所料，你输掉了2000年大选。”

考虑到两党制牢牢控制着美国政治，这几乎毫不意外。更糟的是，你连5%的普选票都没拿到，绿党也就得不到联邦配套资助。
